Sound!

- The 3DO's audio DSP is now emulated, so games play their own music, speech and effects: the console's start-up chime, Star Fighter's intro movie soundtrack, menu music and in-flight sound all play
- Sound can be turned off in Settings
- The game's speed follows the sound output, so audio stays smooth without crackles or drift
- The DSP's DMA channels now behave like the real hardware (stopping, queuing the next buffer and completion interrupts)

Still to come: save states, and testing more games.
